title: Design System: Vanessa Benipayo Working Portfolio

display.purpose: Opening name and one dominant statement per major narrative beat.

body.purpose: Readable explanations, captions, and contact copy capped at 65 to 72 characters per line.

label.purpose: Short coordinates, years, roles, and index metadata.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: A restrained hover or focus lift for media and contact panels.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default transition for opacity and transform changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Remove parallax, auto-advance, and nonessential entrance choreography.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A square graphite action that shifts to oxide on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(21% 0.012 72); color: oklch(96.2% 0.012 65); padding: 16px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font: 600 11px/1.2 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), transform .2s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(56% 0.095 42); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(56% 0.095 42); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Link
components.description: A quiet text action for moving through the dossier.
components.css: .ds-link-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: oklch(21% 0.012 72); font: 600 11px/1.2 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: oklch(80% 0.024 62); text-underline-offset: 5px; transition: color .2s, text-decoration-color .2s; } .ds-link-secondary:hover { color: oklch(56% 0.095 42); text-decoration-color: oklch(56% 0.095 42); } .ds-link-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(56% 0.095 42); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Project Index Row
components.description: A catalog entry with context-rich metadata and a media preview, not a card wall.
components.html: 01Singkaban Cultural CenterMalolos, Bulacan · 2024↗
components.css: .ds-project-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 48px minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(160px, .4fr) 24px; gap: 24px; align-items: baseline; padding: 24px 0; color: oklch(21% 0.012 72); border-top: 1px solid oklch(80% 0.024 62); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s, padding-left .2s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1); } .ds-project-row:hover, .ds-project-row:focus-visible { color: oklch(56% 0.095 42); padding-left: 8px; } .ds-project-number, .ds-project-meta { color: oklch(38% 0.018 63); font: 600 11px/1.2 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-project-name { font: 400 24px/.98 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; } .ds-project-arrow { font-size: 18px; } .ds-project-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(56% 0.095 42); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-project-row { grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr) 20px; gap: 12px; } .ds-project-meta { grid-column: 2 / -1; } }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: A warm inset field with a clear label and oxide focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: oklch(38% 0.018 63); font: 600 11px/1.2 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 16px; background: oklch(90.5% 0.024 57); color: oklch(21% 0.012 72); border: 1px solid oklch(80% 0.024 62); border-radius: 3px; font: 400 15px/1.5 'Albert Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: oklch(38% 0.018 63 / .7); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 0; border-color: oklch(56% 0.095 42); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(56% 0.095 42 / .2); }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio should feel like a drawing set opened on a large table: quiet at first glance, exact on inspection, and full of evidence that a real person has thought through the work. Projects lead the story. The interface is a frame for site, scale, material, and decision making.

This is editorial in its pacing, not in its costume. A restrained serif gives the work a considered voice, while a clear sans-serif handles captions, metadata, and contact. The layout may break its grid when a project needs emphasis, but every offset should feel measured, like a plan detail.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, graphite, and one oxidized accent
Quiet motion with a reduced-motion equivalent
Sharp edges, restrained depth, and generous breathing room

rules.name: The One Notation Rule
rules.body: Oxide is the only chromatic voice. Do not introduce a second accent for hover, status, or decoration.

rules.name: The Title Block Rule
rules.body: Large type should establish the drawing, not shout over it. Use one dominant display moment per viewport and let metadata stay quiet.

rules.name: The Tabletop Rule
rules.body: Surfaces sit on the same table until hierarchy or interaction gives a clear reason to lift them.

dos: Do keep the drawing-paper background and graphite text as the default surface pair.
Do use oxide only for authored emphasis, active state, and clear calls to action.
Do expose location, year, role, scale, and status beside project titles.
Do use real project imagery with descriptive alt text and captions.
Do provide a static equivalent for every meaningful motion sequence.
donts: Don't make the site look like a generic architect portfolio template, a SaaS landing page, or a fashion-editorial mood board.
Don't use dark-tech styling, purple gradients, neon accents, or glassmorphism.
Don't repeat identical feature cards or use a wall of cards as the project index.
Don't use an auto-rotating hero carousel that competes with the work.
Don't use vague architectural clichés such as elevating spaces or empty luxury language.
